note: Experimental adoption is recorded separately from production acceptance; see docs/implementation/DEPENDENCIES.md.

libraries.name: Qt 6 / Qt Quick
libraries.license_notes: LGPL/GPL/commercial depending on module and build
libraries.purpose: Desktop UI, tablet events, accessibility and platform integration.
libraries.integration_boundary: QML visual layer only; no Qt types in domain APIs. QRhi usage is isolated and pinned to tested Qt versions.
libraries.evaluation: SP-01/02/07: real tablets, focus/DPI, graphics integration and clean installations.
libraries.fallback: Use one supported Qt rendering route; reconsider QML docking independently if its candidate fails.

libraries.name: SQLite
libraries.license_notes: Public domain; review bundled extensions separately
libraries.purpose: Metadata, revision transactions and local indices.
libraries.integration_boundary: Project repository adapter. Format 2 commits compressed immutable resources and revision metadata in one database transaction; ADR-012 supersedes the proposed external blob protocol.
libraries.evaluation: SP-03: terminate at every commit boundary, fill disk and recover reachable blobs.
libraries.fallback: Keep the repository port; revise the blob protocol before changing database technology.

libraries.name: Skia
libraries.license_notes: BSD-style; inventory third-party components
libraries.purpose: Vector/raster drawing and a possible CPU reference renderer.
libraries.integration_boundary: Skia is not an editable drawing model, rigging engine or whole compositor. Do not add a second permanent interactive renderer without evidence.
libraries.evaluation: SP-02: compare CPU upload and GPU integration for tablet latency, tile updates, alpha, color and packaging.
libraries.fallback: Use the selected Qt/RHI adapter if Skia integration adds excessive copying or build cost.

libraries.name: Clipper2
libraries.license_notes: BSL-1.0
libraries.purpose: Polygon clipping, offsets and geometric boolean operations.
libraries.integration_boundary: Flatten curves with recorded tolerance, retain curve provenance and keep editable topology in OPEN-TOON.
libraries.evaluation: SP-04: near-coincident edges, holes, self-intersections and large coordinate ranges.
libraries.fallback: Evaluate another maintained polygon kernel against the same corpus; do not silently rasterize edits.

libraries.name: libtess2 / earcut.hpp
libraries.license_notes: Different licenses: verify chosen implementation at pinned revision
libraries.purpose: Select one suitable polygon tessellator for the renderer or mesh preparation.
libraries.integration_boundary: Earcut is an alternative, not an additional mandatory engine; triangle quality for deformation requires further refinement.
libraries.evaluation: Compare holes/degeneracies and topology failures; do not infer solver-quality meshes from fast triangulation.
libraries.fallback: Use renderer-native tessellation for display and a separately justified deformation mesher.

libraries.name: libmypaint
libraries.license_notes: ISC for core; inspect dependencies and brush asset licenses
libraries.purpose: Established pressure-sensitive raster brush engine used by several graphics applications.
libraries.integration_boundary: Integrate the C engine through our tile surface adapter; do not embed the MyPaint application or GTK. Does not provide ABR import.
libraries.evaluation: B0/B3 pressure replay, latency, tile copies, alpha/color conversion and deterministic preset replay.
libraries.fallback: Keep simple native brushes initially and defer advanced presets if the adapter cannot meet budgets.

libraries.name: KDDockWidgets
libraries.license_notes: GPL-2.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only / commercial; inspect chosen files
libraries.purpose: Docking, tabbing and saved workspaces with a Qt Quick frontend.
libraries.integration_boundary: Qt Quick support must be evaluated independently of the mature Widgets path; avoid switching the entire UI for one library.
libraries.evaluation: SP-00/07: nested docks, floating windows, restore, focus, HiDPI, accessibility and monochrome customization.
libraries.fallback: Deliver a constrained QML split-panel layout first if Quick support fails; advanced docking stays incomplete.

libraries.name: miniaudio
libraries.license_notes: Public domain or MIT No Attribution; record the selected option
libraries.purpose: Cross-platform audio device playback, mixing and capture infrastructure.
libraries.integration_boundary: One real-time audio engine; FFmpeg handles media formats outside it. No allocations or document locks in the audio callback.
libraries.evaluation: SP-05: 10-minute rational-rate sync, device replacement, scrub and underrun traces.
libraries.fallback: Evaluate Qt Multimedia behind the same audio port, choosing one engine after measurement.

libraries.name: FFmpeg
libraries.license_notes: Build-dependent LGPL/GPL; nonfree configurations excluded from redistributable profiles
libraries.purpose: Decode imported media and encode supported movie/audio exports.
libraries.integration_boundary: Use a restricted format/codec build and bounded jobs; available codecs are an explicit runtime capability.
libraries.evaluation: Known-timestamp fixtures, cancellation, corrupt input and clean-machine export tests.
libraries.fallback: Always preserve image-sequence and WAV delivery if a movie codec cannot be distributed.

libraries.name: OpenColorIO
libraries.license_notes: Review exact release license plus configuration and LUT licenses
libraries.purpose: Scene/display/output color transformations.
libraries.integration_boundary: Define working space, premultiplied alpha boundaries and CPU/GPU transform equality; library does not choose artistic policy.
libraries.evaluation: B5 charts, negative/HDR values, config changes and GPU/CPU tolerance.
libraries.fallback: A documented restricted sRGB workflow before advanced color support; never claim HDR parity.

libraries.name: OpenImageIO
libraries.license_notes: Review exact release and enabled image codec dependencies
libraries.purpose: Professional image IO and metadata conversion.
libraries.integration_boundary: Start with only required plugins; generic PSD pixels do not guarantee preservation of editable PSD layers.
libraries.evaluation: PNG/TIFF/EXR fixtures, resource limits, metadata/color preservation and package size.
libraries.fallback: Use Qt image IO for the first PNG slice; add professional formats only when their adapters pass.

libraries.name: OpenEXR
libraries.license_notes: Review pinned release and transitive licenses
libraries.purpose: HDR channels and professional image-sequence delivery.
libraries.integration_boundary: Prefer the OpenImageIO path if sufficient; avoid a duplicate reader unless channel/deep-data needs justify it.
libraries.evaluation: B5 half/float values, channels, alpha and round-trip metadata.
libraries.fallback: Defer unsupported channel models with an explicit export report.

libraries.name: OpenTimelineIO
libraries.license_notes: Review core and adapter licenses separately
libraries.purpose: Editorial timeline interchange and rational timing.
libraries.integration_boundary: Map clips/tracks/ranges explicitly; not an animation project interchange format or media renderer.
libraries.evaluation: Nested rates, gaps, missing media and round trips against specified adapter versions.
libraries.fallback: Documented image/audio sequence exchange with timing manifests.

libraries.name: OpenFX
libraries.license_notes: Review host headers, sample code and each external plugin separately
libraries.purpose: Interface specification and support code for third-party effects.
libraries.integration_boundary: Implement declared host suites and process isolation; the API does not supply effects or make arbitrary plugins compatible.
libraries.evaluation: Supported suite tests, crash recovery, ROI/tiles/color and plugin-specific compatibility.
libraries.fallback: Keep native operators usable and mark unsupported plugins clearly.

libraries.name: Eigen
libraries.license_notes: Primarily MPL-2.0; use eligible modules and record any optional dependencies
libraries.purpose: Linear algebra and numerical computations for geometry and rig solvers.
libraries.integration_boundary: Use behind algorithm boundaries; avoid leaking expression-template types across public ABI.
libraries.evaluation: Conditioning, degenerate transforms, precision, vectorization and compile cost.
libraries.fallback: Use small explicit math types for simple operations; restrict solver complexity until proven.

libraries.name: libigl
libraries.license_notes: Primarily MPL-2.0; optional third-party modules carry other terms
libraries.purpose: Selected mesh/geometry processing routines for advanced deformation.
libraries.integration_boundary: Enable only necessary modules; no blanket CGAL/TetGen dependency or assumption of a ready-made product-specific deformer.
libraries.evaluation: SP-06 extended: texture distortion, weight quality, memory and extreme poses.
libraries.fallback: Ship proven bone/curve/envelope tools while advanced solvers remain partial.

libraries.name: pybind11
libraries.license_notes: BSD-style; confirm pinned release
libraries.purpose: Python bindings over the stable command/query API.
libraries.integration_boundary: Bindings do not sandbox Python and must not expose mutable document internals.
libraries.evaluation: Ownership/lifetime, exceptions, version negotiation and worker cancellation.
libraries.fallback: CLI manifest automation remains available if embedded scripting is deferred.

libraries.name: Rhubarb Lip Sync
libraries.license_notes: MIT core; inspect recognizer/model dependencies
libraries.purpose: Optional offline automatic mouth-timing generation.
libraries.integration_boundary: Subprocess adapter with editable results; default speech recognizer is English-oriented, phonetic mode requires separate quality evaluation.
libraries.evaluation: Human review of English and Spanish dialogue, timings, noise and character mouth mappings.
libraries.fallback: Manual lip sync and import of a documented timing file.

libraries.name: ufbx
libraries.license_notes: Verify pinned release and any bundled fixtures
libraries.purpose: FBX scene, hierarchy and animation import candidate.
libraries.integration_boundary: Importer only; materials, animation semantics and safe resource budgets remain our responsibility.
libraries.evaluation: Unit/axis/skin/clip corpus, malformed files and allocator limits.
libraries.fallback: Support an explicitly smaller glTF subset first.

libraries.name: fastgltf
libraries.license_notes: Verify pinned release and transitive dependencies
libraries.purpose: Modern C++ glTF parser candidate.
libraries.integration_boundary: Map assets into our 3D scene contract; parsing does not supply renderer/material support.
libraries.evaluation: External URI handling, extensions, missing buffers, animation and memory limits.
libraries.fallback: Restrict supported glTF extensions and provide actionable import reports.

libraries.name: ONNX Runtime
libraries.license_notes: Audit runtime, execution providers and each model independently
libraries.purpose: Optional local inference runtime for approved assistive tools.
libraries.integration_boundary: Not a source of trained models; each operation needs a compatible, redistributable model and separate quality evidence.
libraries.evaluation: Model conversion, CPU/GPU fallbacks, installation size, latency, peak memory and cancellation.
libraries.fallback: Keep AI optional; unsupported models remain unavailable without affecting normal editing.

libraries.name: nlohmann/json
libraries.license_notes: MIT
libraries.purpose: Readable manifests, configuration and interchange metadata.
libraries.integration_boundary: Bound input depth/size; do not put JSON serialization in tablet sample or render hot paths.
libraries.evaluation: Schema migration, malformed input and metadata size.
libraries.fallback: Keep hot-path snapshots strongly typed.

libraries.name: Zstandard
libraries.license_notes: BSD or GPL options; record chosen eligible license
libraries.purpose: Compress tiles, undo snapshots and packaged resources.
libraries.integration_boundary: Compression policy belongs to storage; bounded decompression and content hashes are still required.
libraries.evaluation: Compression ratio versus edit latency and memory on B3/B6.
libraries.fallback: Store small/hot resources uncompressed if compression harms responsiveness.

libraries.name: libarchive
libraries.license_notes: Inspect BSD-style core and optional format dependencies
libraries.purpose: Portable project/library package transport.
libraries.integration_boundary: Whitelist formats; prevent path traversal, symlink escape, archive bombs and unsafe overwrite.
libraries.evaluation: Unicode paths, duplicate entries, size limits and hostile archives.
libraries.fallback: Use folder-based local projects until safe package transport is ready.

libraries.name: Catch2
libraries.license_notes: BSL-1.0
libraries.purpose: Domain and adapter regression tests.
libraries.integration_boundary: Test behavior/invariants rather than mirroring implementation; UI and artistic review need separate evidence.
libraries.evaluation: Run deterministic fixtures and fault injection in CI.
libraries.fallback: Do not introduce a second C++ unit-test framework without a clear need.

libraries.name: Google Benchmark
libraries.license_notes: Apache-2.0
libraries.purpose: Repeatable isolated CPU benchmarks.
libraries.integration_boundary: Microbenchmarks complement complete app traces; they do not measure physical pen-to-screen latency.
libraries.evaluation: Fixed release build, recorded hardware, repetitions and distribution summaries.
libraries.fallback: Use end-to-end frame/input traces when isolation changes the workload.

libraries.name: Tracy
libraries.license_notes: Verify pinned BSD-style release
libraries.purpose: Developer CPU/GPU/lock/allocation profiling.
libraries.integration_boundary: Developer opt-in instrumentation only; no mandatory user telemetry or recording of artwork.
libraries.evaluation: Measure instrumentation overhead and verify supported graphics backend capture.
libraries.fallback: Platform profilers and local structured timing traces.

libraries.name: CMake / Ninja / Conan 2
libraries.license_notes: Audit tools and every resolved package; package recipe is not upstream ownership
libraries.purpose: Reproducible native builds, dependency graph and lockfiles.
libraries.integration_boundary: Pin exact packages/revisions and flags after spikes; never track moving latest for releases.
libraries.evaluation: Clean builds and dependency restoration on every supported OS.
libraries.fallback: Document a reproducible source-build recipe for dependencies missing a reliable package.

libraries.name: json-c
libraries.license_notes: MIT; notice included in third_party/licenses/json-c
libraries.purpose: libmypaint settings parser dependency.
libraries.integration_boundary: Private dependency of the MyPaint C adapter; document serialization continues to use nlohmann/json.
libraries.evaluation: Pinned engine build and deterministic brush replay; external brush JSON imports remain unsupported.
libraries.fallback: Keep original programmatic presets and validated engine adapter.

libraries.name: OpenSSL Crypto
libraries.license_notes: Apache-2.0; notices included in third_party/licenses/openssl
libraries.purpose: SHA-256 resource identity and integrity verification.
libraries.integration_boundary: Private storage dependency through EVP_Digest; no TLS or network functionality. Zlib is a locked transitive dependency; NASM and Strawberry Perl are platform-specific build requirements.
libraries.evaluation: Corrupt/missing resource rejection, deduplication, atomic save and 4K storage benchmark.
libraries.fallback: Replace the digest adapter while retaining the SHA-256 format contract and compatibility fixtures.
